purpose: Per CEO R297 P0: 'Create three explicit portfolio scores. Do not mix EV with evidence cost and strategic value silently. Show three rankings, not one fake EV ranking.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVII (no threshold invention — every number has provenance). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — MODELLED EV is not buyer evidence).

score_1_TEV.name: Total Expected Transaction Value
score_1_TEV.answers: Which candidate is worth the most?

score_2_EROI.name: Evidence Return on Investment
score_2_EROI.answers: Which candidate gives the most expected value per dollar of evidence?
score_2_EROI.zero_cost_handling: If evidence_cost = $0, EROI is labeled INFINITE_COST_FREE (not infinity). The action is free, so any positive TEV means infinite ROI. But the ABSOLUTE TEV may be small. Both numbers must be shown.

score_3_strategic.name: Strategic Value Score
score_3_strategic.formula: Qualitative 1-5 score based on: platform potential + cross-market applicability + buyer density + time-to-revenue
score_3_strategic.answers: Which candidate deserves parallel strategic attention even if immediate EV is lower?

factors.platform_potential: Can the mechanism apply to multiple markets/products? (1=single product, 5=platform)
factors.cross_market_applicability: Does the technology transfer to other medical domains? (1=single domain, 5=multi-domain)
factors.time_to_revenue: How fast can a transaction close? (1=>12 months, 5=<3 months)

canonical_economics_records.rule: Every candidate has EXACTLY ONE canonical economics record. If multiple artifacts reference different EV values, the canonical record wins. Conflicting values are automatically flagged as INCONSISTENCY.

P5_portfolio_level_information_gain.portfolio_level_optimization: When choosing the next experiment, the machine should ask: 'Which experiment changes the most candidates' probabilities?' not just 'Which candidate has the highest EV?' P-15/P-08 energy budgets affect 4 candidates each for $2K. P-11 phage literature affects 1 candidate for $10K. The portfolio optimizer should favor P-15/P-08 partly because of cross-candidate information gain.

P1_canonical_record_for_P13.previous_conflict: R296 had P-13 EV as both $15K (canonical state) and ~$20K (dataset artifact). This was an inconsistency.
P1_canonical_record_for_P13.resolution: P-13 TEV = $15,000. P_technical = 0.40 (downgraded from 0.60 after collision attack). P_buyer = 0.25 (downgraded from 0.40 because AI prediction is crowded). Value = $150,000 (reduced from $250,000 midpoint because differentiator is narrower). Cost = $0. TEV = 0.40 × 0.25 × $150,000 − $0 = $15,000. This is the SINGLE canonical value. Any artifact referencing $20K is superseded.
P1_canonical_record_for_P13.inconsistency_check: Machine automatically flags any future artifact that references P-13 EV != $15,000 without a documented calculation change.
